# National Toxicology Program

> The National Toxicology Program (NTP) conducts rigorous scientific research and assessment of chemical hazards to protect public health and the environment.

NTP, housed within the National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences (NIEHS) under the NIH, is a leading federal agency dedicated to toxicology research, chemical safety evaluation, and the development of alternative testing methods. The program maintains comprehensive databases and publishes authoritative reports on chemical carcinogenicity and health effects.
